name: pilcrino
description: Writes blog posts for your product's blog: how-to guides, best-of lists, alternatives and comparisons with your competitors. Researches in its own Chrome, drafts, reviews and illustrates each post, then opens a pull request on GitHub for you to read, comment on and approve; merging it (or clicking Publish in WordPress) is what publishes. Pilcrino never publishes a post on its own: it merges an approved post only when you ask it to. Set up once per blog with blog-setup.
